paper.title: Scaling Muon for Diffusion Transformers
paper.abstract: The matrix-aware optimizer Muon improves large model training by balancing updates across singular directions, yet its scaling behavior and end-to-end efficiency on large Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) remain unclear. We first establish Muon's scaling behavior on DiTs from 1.3B to 15B parameters, showing that its optimization and generative quality advantages over AdamW persist across model scales. However, at scale, the 5-step Newton--Schulz iteration (NS5) performed at every optimization step,

summary.core_problem: 评估 Muon 优化器在 1.3B 到 15B Diffusion Transformer 训练中的规模化行为，并解决其 Newton-Schulz 正交化和动量物化带来的训练开销。
summary.importance: 贡献是大模型训练优化器的规模化与系统协同设计。虽然实验对象是 DiT 而非 LLM，但 Muon 的矩阵感知更新、谱方向均衡、分布式动量处理都直接关联大规模预训练优化器选择。
summary.technical_approach: 先系统测量 Muon 相对 AdamW 在不同 DiT 尺度上的优化速度和生成质量优势，再提出 Periodic Row-wise Muon：每 K 步执行一次完整 NS5 spectral update，其余步骤使用基于当前 momentum 的低计算、低通信 row-wise constrained update。实现上避免在非完整更新步全量物化 momentum，直接在 sharded momentum 上操作，降低通信和显存压力。
summary.experiments: 模型规模覆盖 1.3B 到 15B 参数的 Diffusion Transformers。摘要称 Muon 相对 AdamW 的优化与生成质量优势随规模保持，但原始每步 NS5 和 full-momentum materialization 的成本会抵消 step-efficiency；Periodic Row-wise Muon 在保留收益的同时降低计算和通信开销。具体 FID、吞吐和 wall-clock 数字需读正文表格确认。
summary.authors_note: 摘要列出 University of Southern California；作者包括 Chenghao Li、Xiao Han、Xinxin Huang、Wei Liu、Boyang Li、Bing Xiao、Heran Zhang、Juanma Perez Rua、Ke Xu、Kangning Liu 等。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether Muon scales to 1.3B–15B Diffusion Transformers and how to remove the overhead from per-step Newton-Schulz orthogonalization and full momentum materialization.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is large-model optimizer scaling and systems co-design. Although the experiments are on DiTs rather than LLMs, the matrix-aware update, spectral balancing, and sharded-momentum implementation are directly relevant to pretraining optimizer choices.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first measure Muon against AdamW across DiT scales, then introduce Periodic Row-wise Muon. It performs a full NS5 spectral update once every K steps and uses a cheaper row-wise constrained update from the current momentum in the intervening steps. The distributed implementation operates directly on sharded momentum during non-full updates to reduce communication and memory overhead.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments cover Diffusion Transformers from 1.3B to 15B parameters. The abstract reports that Muon's optimization and generative-quality advantages over AdamW persist with scale, while naive per-step NS5 and full momentum materialization can erase wall-clock gains. Exact FID, throughput, and wall-clock numbers require the main tables.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed affiliation is University of Southern California; authors include Chenghao Li, Xiao Han, Xinxin Huang, Wei Liu, Boyang Li, Bing Xiao, Heran Zhang, Juanma Perez Rua, Ke Xu, and Kangning Liu.

recommendation.zh: Muon 从玩具实验走向 15B 训练的成本账值得复现；重点看周期正交化是否也适用于 LLM dense 层。
recommendation.en: The useful part is Muon’s cost accounting at 15B scale; reproduce the periodic orthogonalization idea on LLM dense layers before trusting it.

paper.title: SCOUT: Symmetric Consensus Outlier Detection for Failure Localization in LLM Pre-Training
paper.abstract: In LLM pre-training, synchronization propagates rank-local stalls, slowdowns, and numerical errors into job-wide symptoms, obscuring their origin. Existing diagnosis often relies on in-process monitors that cannot report after the trainer blocks or terminates, or on post-mortem logs that preserve only synchronized symptoms; offline health tests lose the workload and operating conditions that triggered the failure. We present SCOUT, a unified runtime failure-localization framework built on one de

summary.core_problem: 大规模同步LLM预训练中，静默数据损坏、持续性掉队节点、死锁三类潜在故障会被同步机制掩盖为全局作业症状，现有进程内监控、事后日志、离线健康检测均无法定位具体故障rank/设备，导致故障恢复周期长、算力资源浪费。
summary.importance: 为分布式LLM预训练的故障定位提供了统一运行时框架，直接缩短故障恢复耗时、提升有效GPU利用率，填补了现有故障检测仅能标记作业异常、无法给出可执行恢复所需的具体故障组件的缺口，属于训练稳定性与系统可靠性方向的实用工程方案。
summary.technical_approach: 核心设计基于「同数据并行组内等价副本的严格多数共识识别离群点」原则：1）先对齐副本间的训练进度、时序、数值三类证据；2）提出共识集合通信（C3, Consensus Collective Communication）抽象，通过在副本间交换紧凑的rank签名（如梯度/激活统计量、单步迭代耗时、通信时序标记），识别与多数副本特征不一致的异常rank；3）针对性覆盖三类潜在故障：静默数据损坏（数值签名不匹配）、持续性掉队（时序/耗时签名不匹配）、死锁（进度签名不匹配）。与现有方法的差异在于：不依赖进程内监控（rank阻塞或终止时仍可工作）、不使用事后同步日志（运行时基于真实训练负载检测）、不采用离线健康测试（避免遗漏训练负载触发的硬件缺陷）。
summary.experiments: 当前提供的全文片段截断至引言部分的设计观察，未包含完整实验章节。仅从背景引用的行业数据可知：万卡级GPU集群每周出现100-230次关键故障，42.5%的训练任务存在掉队节点，浪费10.4%的分配GPU时长，人工定位单台故障机器平均耗时超30分钟，部分场景需数天。SCOUT的定位准确率、恢复耗时优化等核心实验结果需查阅完整公开版本的后续章节。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先级：1）第1节引言：故障分类与现有方法的核心局限性；2）方法章节：SCOUT的核心设计原则、C3抽象的具体实现；3）方法子章节：三类故障对应的签名设计与共识判定逻辑；4）实验章节：真实生产集群上的故障定位准确率、耗时对比结果。预计阅读时间40-60分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In large-scale synchronous LLM pre-training, three latent failure modes (silent data corruption, recurring stragglers, hangs) are masked into global job-wide symptoms by synchronization mechanisms. Existing in-process monitors, post-mortem logs, and offline health tests cannot pinpoint the specific faulty rank or device, leading to long recovery cycles and wasted compute resources.
summary_en.importance: Delivers a unified runtime framework for failure localization in distributed LLM pre-training, directly cutting recovery latency and improving effective GPU utilization. It fills the gap between current failure detection (which only flags abnormal jobs) and actionable recovery (which requires exact faulty component identification), serving as a practical engineering solution for training stability and system reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Built on the core principle of identifying outliers via strict-majority consensus among equivalent replicas in the same data parallelism group. The workflow has three key steps: 1) Align training progress, timing, and numerical evidence across replicas; 2) Introduce the Consensus Collective Communication (C3) abstraction, which exchanges compact per-rank signatures (e.g., gradient/activation statistics, per-iteration latency, communication timing markers) to detect ranks that deviate from the majority; 3) Target three latent failure modes specifically: silent data corruption (mismatched numerical signatures), recurring stragglers (mismatched timing/latency signatures), and hangs (mismatched progress signatures). Unlike prior methods, it does not rely on in-process monitors (works even if a rank blocks or terminates), avoids post-hoc log correlation (runs at runtime on real training workloads), and skips offline health tests (which miss workload-triggered hardware defects).
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt is truncated at the design observations in the introduction, with no complete experiments section included. Background citations note industry-wide production data: 10k-GPU clusters experience 100–230 critical failures per week, 42.5% of training jobs have stragglers that waste 10.4% of allocated GPU hours, and manual localization of a single faulty machine takes over 30 minutes on average (up to days in some cases). Core experimental results for SCOUT (localization accuracy, recovery latency reduction) require referring to subsequent sections in the full public release.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim priority order: 1) Section 1 (Introduction): Failure taxonomy and core limitations of existing methods; 2) Methodology section: Core design principle of SCOUT and implementation details of the C3 abstraction; 3) Methodology subsections: Signature design and consensus decision logic for the three target failure modes; 4) Experiments section: Localization accuracy and latency comparison results on real production clusters. Estimated reading time: 40–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做大规模预训练 infra 的人值得看，故障定位是真实痛点；C3 共识抽象和带外 observer 设计可直接借鉴到内部训练监控系统。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for anyone running large-scale pretraining infra; the C3 consensus abstraction and out-of-band observer design are directly reusable for internal training monitoring.

paper.title: ZeroLock: Concurrent Memory-Efficient LLM Training via Modular Update Decoupling
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) fine-tuning at the edge adapts the model to scenario-specific data while preserving privacy. Although existing studies proposed pipeline parallelism to address the limited memory and computing resources of edge devices, they commonly rely on backpropagation (BP) training, which has a fundamental limitation of update locking and could experience severe throughput and memory bottlenecks. In this work, we propose a BP-free algorithm, called ZeroLock, that decouples the mo

summary.core_problem: 边缘设备上的 LLM 微调受限于 BP 的 update locking（层间更新必须串行）和激活存储带来的内存/吞吐瓶颈。
summary.importance: 方法/理论创新：首次给出一般模型 chunk 划分下基于 local objective construction 的理论框架，证明收敛率，并在算法层面打破 BP 的 update locking。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 BP-free 算法 ZeroLock，通过 local objective construction 将模型更新解耦为独立的 chunk 更新，从而支持并行更新并减少激活存储。证明在一般 chunk 划分下 local objectives 与 global objective 对齐，收敛率为 Õ(1/√T)。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集或 baseline 对比；主要贡献为理论框架和收敛证明。
summary.authors_note: 无法从摘要确认机构或知名作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM fine-tuning on edge devices is bottlenecked by backpropagation's update locking (sequential layer updates) and activation memory overhead.
summary_en.importance: Method/theory innovation: first theoretical framework for local-objective-construction-based training under general model chunk division, with proven convergence rate, breaking BP's update locking at the algorithm level.
summary_en.technical_approach: ZeroLock, a BP-free algorithm that decouples model updates into independent chunk updates via local objective construction, enabling parallel updates and reduced activation storage. Proves alignment between local and global objectives under general chunk division with Õ(1/√T) convergence.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model scale, dataset, or baseline comparison in abstract; main contribution is theoretical framework and convergence proof.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and notable author background not identifiable from abstract.

recommendation.zh: BP-free 训练的理论框架有新意，但目标场景是边缘微调，对大规模预训练的直接迁移性存疑；看收敛证明和 chunk 划分假设即可。
recommendation.en: The BP-free training theory is novel, but the edge-finetuning target makes direct transfer to large-scale pretraining uncertain; read the convergence proof and chunk-division assumptions.

paper.title: Dual-Node NVIDIA DGX Spark over Tailscale: A Remote-Access Testbed for Distributed LLM Training and Cyber-Threat-Intelligence Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: Compact AI systems make local language-model experimentation increasingly accessible, yet practical evidence for multi-node training on desktop-class accelerators remains limited. This report presents a proof-of-concept deployment of distributed NanoChat pretraining across two NVIDIA DGX Spark systems, each with a GB10 Grace Blackwell system-on-chip and 128 GB of unified memory, administered remotely over a Tailscale mesh VPN and connected for training by a dedicated 200 Gb/s QSFP56 direct fiber

summary.core_problem: 验证两台桌面级 NVIDIA DGX Spark 通过远程 VPN 管理和 200 Gb/s 直连网络运行小规模分布式 LLM 预训练是否可行，并记录实际工程问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是训练系统实践报告。它不是新的预训练方法，但把小型多节点训练中的 NCCL、DDP、网络绑定、checkpoint 和故障排查细节写得比较具体，可作为低成本实验环境的运维参考。
summary.technical_approach: 系统由两台 DGX Spark 组成，每台搭载 GB10 Grace Blackwell SoC 和 128 GB unified memory；远程管理使用 Tailscale mesh VPN，训练通信走 200 Gb/s QSFP56 直连光纤。训练侧使用 PyTorch torchrun、DDP 和 NCCL，每节点一个进程，运行 depth-20 NanoChat 预训练。
summary.experiments: 设置为每节点 local batch size 32、上下文长度 2048，global batch 为每步 131,072 tokens。四天处理约 653M tokens，平均 step time 约 69.4 秒，吞吐约 1,890 tokens/s。报告还记录了 step-zero evaluation bug 导致 NCCL timeout 的问题和修复路径。
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA 相关硬件和训练系统实践报告；作者为 Vasanth Iyer。

summary_en.core_problem: The report tests whether two desktop-class NVIDIA DGX Spark systems can run small-scale distributed LLM pretraining under remote administration and a dedicated high-speed interconnect.
summary_en.importance: This is an engineering practice report rather than a new pretraining method. Its value lies in concrete operational details around NCCL, DDP, interface binding, checkpointing, and failure diagnosis for small multi-node LLM experiments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup uses two DGX Spark machines, each with a GB10 Grace Blackwell SoC and 128 GB of unified memory. Remote administration runs over a Tailscale mesh VPN, while training traffic uses a 200 Gb/s QSFP56 direct fiber link. The training stack uses PyTorch torchrun, DDP, and NCCL with one process per node on a depth-20 NanoChat model.
summary_en.experiments: The run uses a local batch size of 32 per node and a 2,048-token context, giving 131,072 tokens per global step. It sustains about 69.4 seconds per step, around 1,890 tokens/s, and processes roughly 653M tokens over four days. The report also documents a step-zero evaluation bug that triggered NCCL timeouts.
summary_en.authors_note: An NVIDIA-related hardware and training-systems practice report by Vasanth Iyer.

recommendation.zh: 当作小集群 pretrain 运维清单看，不是研究信号；Fig/配置表比结论更有用。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a small-cluster pretraining ops checklist, not a research signal; the configs and failure notes matter more than the conclusion.

paper.title: Tevatron Meets Megatron: Expert-Parallel LLM Reranker Training on an Academic Budget
paper.abstract: Modern reranking recipes---billion-scale cross-encoders, mixture-of-experts (MoE) backbones, and distillation against strong teachers---have outpaced the training infrastructure available to most academic groups. Existing Tevatron reranker training relies on the Hugging Face Trainer with DeepSpeed or PyTorch FSDP1, but these backends lack efficient support for large-scale MoE training. We present Tevatron 3.0, which integrates a Megatron-Core training backend into Tevatron while preserving its d

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是 LLM reranker 训练的工程可复现性问题：现代 reranker 已经转向十亿级 cross-encoder、蒸馏训练和 MoE backbone，但常用的 Tevatron + Hugging Face Trainer + DeepSpeed/FSDP1 路径在可靠性、吞吐和专家并行上都跟不上。目标不是提出新的 reranking 损失，而是把 Megatron-Core 后端接入 Tevatron，使 dense 和 MoE reranker 能在较有限的学术算力下训练和评估。
summary.importance: 对预训练方向的直接贡献有限，因为它主要服务 reranker 训练和检索系统。但它对大模型训练系统有现实参考：MoE 不能只靠参数分片解决，专家路由需要 expert parallelism；FSDP1 能跑通不等于吞吐合理；保持数据路径、评测接口和 HF checkpoint 兼容，能显著降低训练后端迁移成本。对做 MoE post-training、检索增强模型训练、cross-encoder 蒸馏的人，这类系统细节比单个榜单分数更有用。
summary.technical_approach: Tevatron 3.0 在原有 Tevatron 2.0 上增加 Megatron 训练后端，保留数据读取、collator、评测流程和 Hugging Face 可加载 checkpoint 格式。权重通过 HFMegatron bridge 转换。dense 8B reranker 使用 Megatron 的分布式优化器和 tensor parallelism；MoE reranker 使用 Megatron expert parallelism，避免 FSDP1 对专家层的复制再分片。系统还支持 LoRA、全参数微调、listwise-KL 蒸馏和 contrastive loss，并提供统一评测接口：一种用于本地 ranklist scoring，另一种通过 HTTP 调用 HF/vLLM scoring server pool 做 rerank-and-score。论文还加入了 MoE LoRA target-group registry，确保低秩适配正确作用到专家层。
summary.experiments: 系统评估主要围绕可训练性、吞吐和端到端效果。作者比较了 DDP、FSDP1 的 shard_grad_op/full_shard，以及 Megatron 后端。DDP 在 8B reranker 上会 OOM；FSDP1 能省显存但吞吐不理想，full_shard 相比较轻的 shard_grad_op 没有带来对应速度收益。Megatron 推荐配置训练 dense 8B 约快 22%，并能保持与 FSDP 训练相当的质量。MoE 方面，Qwen3-30B-A3B 这类 30B 总参数、A3B 激活参数、128 experts 的 reranker 可以用 expert parallelism 训练，而 FSDP1 路径无法高效支持。端到端演示覆盖 dense 8B 与 MoE 30B-A3B、LoRA 与全参、listwise-KL 与 contrastive，在 BEIR-15 上用三种 first-stage retriever 评测；示例结果显示 MoE reranker 在低于 dense 8B 一半激活参数的情况下达到相近质量，并有更高推理吞吐。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看系统设计章节，尤其是 Megatron backend 如何接入 Tevatron 数据路径、checkpoint 转换和评测接口。后端 profiling 部分比 BEIR 分数更重要，可以关注 FSDP1、distributed optimizer、tensor parallelism 和 expert parallelism 的对比。MoE LoRA target registry 适合做 MoE 微调的人细看。端到端 BEIR 实验可快速浏览，主要确认系统能覆盖常见训练 recipe，不宜把它当作新的 reranker 方法论文来读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a systems bottleneck in training LLM-based rerankers. Modern reranking recipes use billion-scale cross-encoders, distillation, and increasingly MoE backbones, while the existing Tevatron path through Hugging Face Trainer, DeepSpeed, and PyTorch FSDP1 is unreliable or inefficient for these workloads. The goal is to make dense and MoE reranker training reproducible under an academic-scale budget by adding a Megatron-Core backend to Tevatron.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining-method paper, but it is useful for researchers who train large post-training or retrieval models. The paper makes a practical point: parameter sharding alone is not enough for MoE training, because routed experts need expert parallelism. It also shows that a memory-safe FSDP configuration can still be throughput-poor. The compatibility choices are important: keeping the same data path, evaluation pipeline, and Hugging Face-loadable checkpoint format reduces the cost of switching training backends.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tevatron 3.0 adds a Megatron training backend while preserving Tevatron’s existing data pipeline, collator, evaluation interface, and checkpoint conventions. The implementation uses bridge-based HFMegatron weight conversion. For dense rerankers, the backend uses a Megatron-style distributed optimizer with tensor parallelism. For MoE rerankers, it uses expert parallelism so that active experts are routed and parallelized properly rather than replicated and sharded as ordinary parameters. The toolkit supports LoRA, full-parameter tuning, listwise-KL distillation, and contrastive training. It also adds a unified evaluation layer with local ranklist scoring and remote rerank-and-score through HF or vLLM scoring servers. A named LoRA target-group registry is introduced so adapters can be attached correctly to MoE expert layers.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation focuses on trainability and throughput. For an 8B reranker, DDP runs out of memory. FSDP1 configurations fit but have limited throughput, and full_shard does not deliver a meaningful speed advantage over lighter sharding. The recommended Megatron configuration trains the dense 8B reranker about 22% faster while matching FSDP-trained quality. For MoE, the system trains a 30B-A3B reranker with 128 experts using expert parallelism, a setting that the FSDP1 path cannot support efficiently. The end-to-end demonstration sweeps dense 8B versus MoE 30B-A3B, LoRA versus full-parameter tuning, and listwise-KL distillation versus contrastive loss, evaluated on BEIR-15 with three first-stage retrievers. The reported demonstration shows the MoE reranker matching dense-8B quality with less than half the activated parameters and better inference throughput.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the system design and backend characterization. The most useful parts are the integration of Megatron into Tevatron, the checkpoint conversion path, and the comparison between FSDP1, the distributed optimizer, tensor parallelism, and expert parallelism. The MoE LoRA target registry is worth reading if you fine-tune routed models. The BEIR experiments are mainly a capability check for the framework; they should not be read as the central methodological contribution.

recommendation.zh: 只看 Megatron-Core 接入和 EP ablation；对预训练没新 recipe，但能校准小团队做 MoE 训练的工程边界。
recommendation.en: Read the Megatron-Core integration and EP ablations; no new pretraining recipe, but it calibrates the engineering limits for small-team MoE training.

paper.title: Incast-Free MoE Rate-Based Scheduling
paper.abstract: Mixture of Experts (MoE) architectures have become key to large language models; however, their typical round-robin (RR) scheduling introduces significant bottlenecks.   In this paper, we demonstrate that RR causes a previously-undiscovered exponential incast phenomenon with MoE traffic. We propose an alternative proactive fair scheduling framework tailored for MoE workloads, which effectively prevents fabric oversubscription. We also outline how it can be implemented in NICs. Finally, through e

summary.core_problem: MoE 训练与推理中的 all-to-all token dispatch 在常用的 NIC 级 round-robin 调度下会产生一种结构性的指数级 incast 拥塞，导致 Collective Completion Time 膨胀、链路利用率下降，而现有的 BvN 类全局同步方案在真实数据中心条件下难以落地。
summary.importance: 这是一个偏系统/网络层的工作，但对大规模 MoE 预训练有直接工程意义：MoE 的扩展瓶颈不只在路由算法和专家并行策略，也在 all-to-all 流量在网卡/交换机侧的调度方式。论文指出 RR 在偏斜流量下的失效不是参数调优问题，而是协议层面的结构性问题，并给出一个可在现代 SmartNIC/DPU 上落地的无 incast 速率分配框架。对做大规模 MoE 训练系统、尤其是关注跨节点 all-to-all 开销的研究员，这是值得了解的系统侧信号。
summary.technical_approach: 作者首先对 MoE 流量建模，证明在偏斜（Zipfian）流量矩阵下，各发送方独立 RR 调度时，去往冷 expert 的轻量流会先耗尽，剩余活跃目的地数量指数衰减，导致热点接收方的聚合到达速率指数上升，形成 exponential incast。即使开启 UEC NSCC 这类反应式拥塞控制，也会因为过度反压而把链路利用率压低。解决方案是 proactive fair scheduling：基于当前 token 流量矩阵，按行/列需求的最大值做归一化，为每个流分配一个保证不超过发送端和接收端物理线速的速率权重，从数学上消除端口超额订阅，从而在设计上避免 incast。实现上把速率权重直接写入 NVIDIA DOCA PCC 等 NIC 硬件可编程路径，绕过复杂握手，千流量级的权重重编程可在 10 μs 内完成。
summary.experiments: 在 64×64 到 512×512 的三级 fat-tree 非阻塞拓扑下，使用 Qwen2/3 MoE 的真实 workload 和合成 Zipfian workload 做仿真。相比 RR + UEC NSCC baseline，该调度框架消除了 incast，链路利用率接近 100%，并显著降低 CCT。论文给出了 incast 增长的理论证明，以及随 GPU 数量 N 扩大时 RR+CCA 过度节流效应加剧的趋势。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可。重点看第 3 节对 exponential incast 的直觉解释和证明，这是论文最有价值的洞察；再看速率归一化的构造（按 max(row sum, col sum) 缩放）以及 NIC 实现部分的时延估算，判断这个方案在自己系统栈里的可落地性。仿真实验部分看结论即可，不需要细抠曲线。预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Round-robin scheduling at the NIC, widely used for MoE all-to-all token dispatch in datacenters, creates a structural exponential incast bottleneck under skewed expert traffic, while globally synchronized BvN-style scheduling is difficult to deploy under realistic RTT, failure, and background-traffic conditions.
summary_en.importance: This is a systems/networking paper, but it has direct relevance to large-scale MoE pretraining. It shows that a major bottleneck in expert-parallel training is not only routing or expert placement but also NIC-level scheduling of all-to-all traffic. The incast failure mode of RR is not a tuning artifact but a protocol-level pathology under skew, and the proposed rate-based scheme provides a deployable path to eliminate it on modern SmartNICs/DPUs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors first model MoE traffic under skewed (Zipfian) demand and prove that independent RR senders drain light flows to cold experts exponentially fast, leaving all senders transmitting to hot receivers at full line rate near the end of an epoch, which causes exponential incast. Reactive congestion control such as UEC NSCC mitigates buffer overflow but over-corrects, dropping link utilization below 100% and inflating CCT. The proposed solution is a proactive proportional rate-allocation framework: given the current traffic matrix, rates are normalized by the worst-case row and column demands so that aggregate arrival at every sender and receiver never exceeds physical link capacity, eliminating oversubscription by construction. The rate weights are programmed directly into NIC hardware via interfaces such as NVIDIA DOCA PCC, avoiding complex control-plane handshakes; weight updates for up to 1,000 flows can be programmed in under 10 μs.
summary_en.experiments: Simulations on 64×64 to 512×512 three-tier non-blocking fat-tree topologies use both Qwen2/3 MoE traces and synthetic Zipfian workloads. The scheduler eliminates incast, maintains near-100% link utilization, and substantially reduces CCT compared with RR plus UEC NSCC. The paper also provides a theoretical proof of exponential incast growth and shows that the over-throttling problem of RR+reactive CCA worsens as N scales.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the exponential incast intuition and proof in Section 3, which is the core insight; then read the rate-normalization construction and the NIC implementation subsection to assess deployability in your own stack. The simulation plots can be read at a high level. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: MoE 训练系统值得看；若你还默认 RR 足够公平，abstract 里的“指数级 incast”应立刻进内部网络仿真复现。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for MoE training systems; if you still assume round-robin is harmlessly fair, the claimed exponential incast deserves immediate internal simulation.

paper.title: Pipelined Gradient Coding
paper.abstract: In large-scale machine learning, distributed training commonly involves multiple workers evaluating the gradients of the model on different dataset partitions. A common challenge is the presence of straggling workers, which may significantly slow down training. Traditional gradient coding (GC) addresses this by duplicating dataset partitions across workers, allowing for the replacement of missing gradients from stragglers. However, GC requires workers to evaluate gradients on multiple dataset pa

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是分布式训练里的经典瓶颈：straggler 会拖慢每一步的梯度聚合，而传统 gradient coding 虽然能容忍 straggler，却要求每个 worker 在每一步额外计算多个数据分片的梯度，常常把“抗拖尾”换成了“更高计算时延”。论文要解决的不是编码能不能恢复全梯度，而是如何在不增加单步计算负担的前提下，保留 gradient coding 的容错能力。
summary.importance: 对大模型预训练的直接启发不在建模范式，而在训练系统层面的取舍：很多容错方法默认通信或恢复是主矛盾，但在真实训练里，额外前向/反向计算往往更贵。这篇论文给出的结论很明确：如果编码方案把每步计算量放大 c=s+1 倍，那么即便能少等 straggler，端到端 wall-clock 也可能更差。它的价值在于把“编码冗余”改写成“跨步流水化冗余”，这对大规模异构集群、低稳定性云资源、或弹性训练环境有参考意义。不过它离当前主流 LLM 训练栈还有距离，更多是系统思路上的启发，而不是可以直接照搬的 recipe。
summary.technical_approach:
核心方法是 Pipelined Gradient Coding, PGC。思路很朴素但设计上不简单：传统 GC 在同一步里让每个 worker 计算 c 个分片梯度，再上传编码后的线性组合；PGC 则把这 c 份计算拆到连续多个 step 中，每个 worker 每一步只算 1 个分片，因此单步计算负担回到和普通 DGD 一样。为了仍然能恢复全局梯度，PGC 让当前 step 上传的 coded gradient 同时依赖当前和历史 step 已经算过的分片梯度，于是形成跨时间的流水线。

论文分别为两类经典 placement 设计了 PGC：
1. Fractional Repetition (FR)：worker 分组后共享相同数据放置。PGC-FR 的编码和恢复相对简单，利用组内冗余在不同 step 上逐步补齐各分片贡献。
2. Cyclic Repetition (CR)：数据分片按循环方式放置，更灵活，不要求 c|n。PGC-CR 需要更复杂的线性编码与依赖 straggler pattern 的解码。

方法上的关键点有三个。第一，计算与容错解耦：把原本同一步内的 c 倍计算展开到 c 个 step。第二，引入 pipeline delay，模型更新使用的是带时延的聚合梯度，因此论文需要重新分析收敛。第三，证明在光滑/强凸等设定下，PGC 仍可收敛，并给出与延迟相关的界。换句话说，它不是“免费容错”，而是用可分析的梯度时延去换取更低的单步完成时间。

和已有 GC 相比，区别不在编码矩阵本身，而在时间维度的重排。GC 是空间冗余主导；PGC 是空间冗余加时间流水化。和普通异步 SGD 相比，PGC 不是简单接受 stale gradient，而是通过结构化编码让 master 仍能恢复目标聚合量，只是这个聚合量来自跨步计算。
summary.experiments:
实验分两层。第一层是动机验证：作者在 12 台 Google Cloud VM 上训练 ResNet-18/CIFAR-10，一个 epoch 内比较 DGD、GC-FR、GC-CR。结果显示，虽然 GC 与 DGD 在每 step 的 loss 轨迹一致，因为都恢复了全梯度，但 GC 的 step time 明显更长，文中给出的结论是相对 DGD 超过 100%，且随着可容忍 straggler 数 s 增大，差距继续扩大；GC-FR 又快于 GC-CR，原因是编码复杂度更低。

第二层是 PGC 的收益验证。论文通过仿真和真实实验比较 completion time 与收敛速度，结论是 PGC 在保持和 DGD 相近单步计算开销的同时，能比传统 GC 更有效地降低总训练时间，并在 wall-clock 维度上更快收敛。这里要注意，论文强调的是“按时间收敛更快”，不一定是“按 step 收敛更快”，因为 PGC 引入了延迟梯度。对读者更有价值的观察是：在 straggler 不算极端、但 GC 计算放大明显的区间，PGC 的优势最成立；如果系统瓶颈主要是通信而不是计算，收益可能会缩小。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议控制在 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Preliminary，抓住作者为什么认为传统 GC 在真实系统里常常不划算。然后重点看 Fig. 3，这张图基本把论文动机讲透了：GC 恢复了同样的梯度，却因为每步多算 c 个分片而更慢。

接着看方法部分里 PGC 对 FR 和 CR 的构造，理解“每步只算一个分片，但跨步编码恢复”的机制即可，不必一开始就陷入全部符号。若时间有限，优先看 FR 版本，因为更直观。最后扫一眼收敛定理和实验部分，确认作者如何处理 pipeline delay，以及收益是在 step 维度还是 wall-clock 维度体现。

值得深挖的点有两个：一是这种跨步编码在现代 data-parallel LLM 训练里如何与 gradient accumulation、pipeline parallel、elastic training 结合；二是当优化器不是简单 SGD，而是 AdamW 一类带状态优化器时，延迟梯度对训练动态的影响会不会更复杂。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a practical systems issue in distributed training: stragglers slow down synchronous gradient aggregation, while classic gradient coding tolerates stragglers only by making each worker compute gradients on multiple data partitions per step. That extra computation can erase the benefit of straggler mitigation. The real question here is not whether coded gradients can recover the full gradient, but how to retain that robustness without inflating per-step compute.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is mostly at the training-systems level. The paper makes a useful point for large-scale training: many fault-tolerance schemes assume waiting time is the main bottleneck, but in real runs extra forward/backward work is often more expensive than moderate straggling. The contribution is to turn coding redundancy into pipelined redundancy across steps. This is not a drop-in recipe for modern LLM stacks, but it is a meaningful systems idea for elastic or heterogeneous clusters where worker slowdown is common.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is Pipelined Gradient Coding (PGC). Standard gradient coding assigns each worker c=s+1 data partitions and asks it to compute all c gradients in the same step, then upload a coded linear combination. PGC spreads those c computations across multiple consecutive steps, so each worker computes only one partition gradient per step, matching the per-step compute cost of ordinary distributed gradient descent.

To preserve recoverability, the coded message at a given step is formed from gradients computed at the current and previous steps. This creates a temporal pipeline: redundancy is no longer concentrated within one step, but distributed over time.

The paper develops PGC for two classic placement schemes:
1. Fractional Repetition (FR): workers are grouped and share the same partition placement. PGC-FR is simpler to encode and decode.
2. Cyclic Repetition (CR): partitions are placed cyclically, which is more flexible and does not require c to divide n, but decoding is more involved and depends on the straggler pattern.

The main technical shift is from purely spatial redundancy to spatial-plus-temporal redundancy. This introduces delayed gradients, so the paper also provides convergence analysis under smooth and strongly convex settings. In other words, PGC trades extra same-step computation for analyzable gradient staleness. Compared with asynchronous SGD, the delay here is structured by coding rather than being an uncontrolled side effect of worker timing.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments first validate the motivation. On 12 Google Cloud VMs, training ResNet-18 on CIFAR-10 for one epoch, the authors compare vanilla distributed gradient descent with GC under FR and CR placement. All methods follow the same loss-per-step trajectory because they recover the same full gradient, but GC is consistently slower per step. The paper states that the slowdown relative to DGD exceeds 100%, and the gap widens as the tolerated straggler count s increases. GC-FR is faster than GC-CR due to lower coding complexity.

The second part evaluates PGC through simulations and real experiments. The main result is that PGC substantially reduces completion time relative to standard GC and improves convergence in wall-clock time, while keeping per-step compute close to DGD. The important nuance is that the gain is primarily in time-to-train, not necessarily in steps-to-convergence, since PGC uses delayed gradients. The method is most attractive when stragglers are present but not catastrophic, and when the compute amplification of standard GC is the dominant cost.
summary_en.reading_guide:
A skim read should take about 20–30 minutes. Start with the introduction and preliminary section to understand why the authors think classic GC is often a poor systems trade-off. Then look closely at Fig. 3; it captures the paper’s motivation well: same recovered gradient, much worse step time.

Next, read the construction of PGC for FR and CR. If time is limited, focus on the FR version first because it is easier to internalize. The key idea to retain is simple: one partition per worker per step, but coded recovery across multiple steps. After that, scan the convergence section to see how pipeline delay is handled, and then the experiments to check whether the benefit appears in step efficiency or wall-clock efficiency.

Two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: how this kind of temporal coding would interact with gradient accumulation, pipeline parallelism, or elastic training in LLM pretraining; and whether delayed coded gradients behave differently under adaptive optimizers such as AdamW compared with plain SGD.

recommendation.zh: 做大规模分布式预训练系统的可参考，重点看流水线设计和收敛证明，是缓解straggler的新思路。
recommendation.en: Useful for distributed pretraining system researchers; focus on the pipelined design and convergence proofs as a novel approach to straggler mitigation.

paper.title: SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD

While most large-scale LLM training systems are built around GPU-based clusters, this report presents an end-to-end optimization practice on the Ascend NPU SuperPOD. Using the DeepSeek-V4 model family as the target workload, we develop a hi

summary.core_problem: 解决万亿级 MoE 模型在 Ascend NPU 集群上做全参数后训练时的内存、通信重叠和 kernel 效率问题。
summary.importance: 这是大规模训练系统与 recipe 的工程报告，价值在于把 GPU 主导的 LLM 训练经验迁移到 Ascend SuperPOD，并给出可落地的分层优化框架。对做大规模预训练/后训练基础设施的人，信息密度很高。
summary.technical_approach: 工作以 DeepSeek-V4 family 为目标负载，提出覆盖三层的端到端优化：模型级并行与切分、计算-通信编排与重叠、底层 kernel 执行优化。作者把这些系统优化整合为 SLAI T-Rex，并在其上建立 CPT 与 SFT 工作流，说明系统不仅能跑通 benchmark，还能支撑复杂任务后训练。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的核心结果是 MFU 达到 34.22%，相对开源 baseline recipe 提升 2.93 倍，同时保持训练稳定。论文聚焦系统效率与稳定性，而不是模型能力刷新；从预训练研究视角，最值得看的是并行策略、通信编排和稳定性处理细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自深圳环湾研究院 AI Training Platform Team，论文以 DeepSeek-V4 family 为目标工作负载，属于头部实验室相关的大规模训练系统实践。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles memory pressure, communication overlap, and kernel-efficiency bottlenecks in full-parameter post-training of trillion-scale MoE models on Ascend NPU clusters.
summary_en.importance: This is a large-scale training-systems report. Its value lies in translating GPU-centric LLM training practice into an Ascend SuperPOD setting and presenting an end-to-end optimization stack that is directly relevant to large-scale pretraining and post-training infrastructure.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using the DeepSeek-V4 family as the target workload, the authors build a hierarchical optimization framework spanning model-level parallelism, compute-communication orchestration, and low-level kernel execution. They package the system as SLAI T-Rex and further demonstrate CPT and SFT workflows on top of it.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result in the abstract is 34.22% MFU, a 2.93x improvement over an open-source baseline recipe, while preserving training stability. The paper is about systems efficiency and stability rather than capability gains; for pretraining researchers, the key sections are parallelism, overlap strategy, and stability engineering.
summary_en.authors_note: The team is from the AI Training Platform Team at Shenzhen Loop Area Institute, and the work is built around the DeepSeek-V4 family, making it a notable large-scale training-systems practice tied to a top lab ecosystem.

recommendation.zh: 这类报告会直接改你对“非 CUDA 集群能否高效训大 MoE”的先验；先复现其并行与通信重叠设计，再看 MFU 是否能在自家栈上站住。
recommendation.en: This should update your prior on whether non-CUDA clusters can train giant MoEs efficiently; first inspect the parallelism and overlap design, then test whether the MFU story survives on your own stack.

paper.title: Fine-grained Computation-Communication Overlap via Tile-level Signaling and Scheduling for Mixture-of-Experts
paper.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures increase model capacity without proportionally increasing computation cost and have become a key building block for scaling large language models (LLMs) to trillion-parameter regimes. Efficient deployment of these MoE models relies on distributed execution across multiple GPUs, where each MoE layer involves two all-to-all communications: dispatching tokens to expert ranks and returning the expert outputs to their source ranks. Conventional MoE implementatio

summary.core_problem: 分布式MoE推理场景下，专家计算完成后才启动返回路径的all-to-all通信，通信延迟处于关键路径，导致GPU利用率偏低。现有粗粒度分块重叠方法在小分块时损失张量核效率，且存在主机同步开销；内核融合方法则需要侵入式的自定义协议，实现复杂度高。
summary.importance: 为MoE大模型推理的计算通信重叠优化提供了一种轻量级方案，无需修改通信库或深度融合内核即可实现细粒度重叠，对MoE推理系统的工程实现有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 核心是tile级设备信号协调的生产者-消费者模式。将专家输出投影GEMM（生产者）与返回all-to-all通信（消费者）作为持久内核，运行在独立划分的SM分区上，避免资源竞争。GEMM每完成一个tile就发出设备端信号，消费者检测到对应段的所有tile完成后，立即发起段粒度的远程写入，全程无需主机端同步。关键设计为remote-owner-aligned行布局，使每个输出tile仅对应一个目标rank，通信内核无需逐行路由逻辑，可直接执行连续写入。该方案既保留了完整张量核效率（无需切分小chunk），又避免了融合内核的高实现成本。
summary.experiments: 当前公开的部分内容未包含完整实验章节，核心贡献集中在方法设计层面，具体性能提升数据需参考原文完整版本。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注tile级信号协调机制与remote-owner-aligned行布局的设计细节，以及性能实测章节（如有）。预计阅读时间15-20分钟，适合关注MoE分布式推理优化的系统方向研究员参考。

summary_en.core_problem: In distributed MoE inference, the return-path all-to-all communication is launched only after expert compute finishes, leaving communication latency on the critical path and reducing GPU utilization. Existing coarse-grained chunk-based overlap methods degrade tensor-core efficiency at small chunk sizes and incur host synchronization overhead; kernel fusion approaches require intrusive custom protocols with high implementation complexity.
summary_en.importance: Provides a lightweight scheme for compute-communication overlap optimization in MoE LLM inference, achieving fine-grained overlap without modifying communication libraries or building deeply fused kernels, with practical reference value for MoE inference system engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design is a producer-consumer pattern coordinated by tile-level device-resident signals. Both the expert output projection GEMM (producer) and the return all-to-all communication (consumer) run as persistent kernels on disjoint SM partitions to avoid resource contention. The GEMM raises a signal per completed tile; the consumer initiates segment-granular remote writes as soon as all tiles in a segment are ready, with no host-side synchronization on the critical path. A key optimization is the remote-owner-aligned row layout, which aligns each output tile with exactly one destination rank, so the communication kernel can issue contiguous writes without per-row routing logic. This design preserves full tensor-core efficiency (no small chunk splitting) while avoiding the high engineering cost of fused kernels.
summary_en.experiments: The provided partial content does not include the full experimental section. Core contributions are focused on method design; specific performance improvement metrics require referring to the complete paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the tile-level signaling mechanism and the remote-owner-aligned row layout design, plus the performance benchmark section if available. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes. Relevant for researchers working on MoE distributed inference systems.

recommendation.zh: 针对 MoE All-to-All 通信瓶颈的底层系统优化，Tile 级别的细粒度重叠思路值得做 MoE 训练/推理系统优化的工程师关注。
recommendation.en: Low-level system optimization targeting the MoE All-to-All communication bottleneck; the tile-level fine-grained overlap approach is worth attention for engineers optimizing MoE training/inference systems.

paper.title: FVAttn: Adaptive Sparse Attention with Runtime Load Balancing for Video Generation
paper.abstract: Video Diffusion Transformers process long spatio-temporal sequences, making self-attention the main bottleneck in high-resolution video generation. Training-free sparse attention reduces this cost, but adaptive Top-$p$ routing creates uneven per-head workloads under multi-GPU sequence parallelism. The resulting workload heterogeneity turns sparse attention into a rank-level straggler problem. summary.core_problem: 视频扩散Transformer中，训练无关的自适应Top-p稀疏注意力在多GPU序列并行下会出现各头负载不均，导致秩级straggler问题，降低分布式执行效率。
summary.importance: 系统类工作，指出了自适应稀疏注意力在分布式序列并行下的负载失衡痛点，提出的运行时负载均衡方案对长序列模型的分布式效率优化有少量参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出FVAttn训练无关稀疏注意力系统：1）前端采用Top-p路由加Top-k安全下限、视频感知块组织做稀疏路由，运行时修正物化掩码；2）运行时负载均衡通过P2P通信迁移少量计算过重的attention head，缩短关键路径；3）Slack感知稀疏增强利用非关键秩的空闲算力填充额外高价值块；4）算子调度重叠掩盖开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提及具体模型参数量、baseline对比或速度提升幅度，仅描述系统设计思路。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中山大学、腾讯微信HPC/微信视觉团队、北京大学，腾讯微信团队负责视频生成相关系统优化工作。

summary_en.core_problem: In video Diffusion Transformers, training-free adaptive Top-p sparse attention causes uneven per-head workloads under multi-GPU sequence parallelism, leading to rank-level stragglers that degrade distributed execution efficiency.
summary_en.importance: A systems work identifying the load imbalance pain point of adaptive sparse attention in distributed sequence parallel settings, with a runtime load balancing solution that provides minor reference value for long-sequence model distributed optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes FVAttn, a training-free sparse attention system: 1) a sparse routing frontend with Top-p routing, a Top-k safety floor, and video-aware block organization, with runtime mask materialization repair; 2) runtime load balancing that migrates overloaded attention heads via P2P communication to shorten the critical path; 3) slack-aware sparse augmentation that fills residual idle compute on non-critical ranks with additional high-value attention blocks; 4) overlapped scheduling to hide overhead.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report specific model scales, baseline comparisons, or speedup numbers; only system design is described.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Sun Yat-sen University, Tencent WeChat HPC/WeChat Vision, and Peking University; the WeChat team works on video generation system optimization.

recommendation.zh: 针对视频DiT的稀疏注意力分布式优化，思路可参考但块设计绑定视频结构，做长序列LLM并行的人扫下负载均衡部分即可。
recommendation.en: A distributed sparse attention optimization for video DiTs; the load balancing idea is transferable but block design is video-specific; only scan the load balancing section if working on long-sequence LLM parallelism.

paper.title: Agora: Collective and Permissionless Internet-Scale Pretraining of Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Training large language models at the multi-billion to trillion parameter scale is confined to datacenters, where data-parallel (DP) and model-parallel (MP) techniques presume homogeneous accelerators, high-speed interconnects, and a single orchestrating entity. Frontier model development is thereby concentrated among the few groups able to assemble such clusters. Meanwhile, an enormous pool of compute remains unusable for training: consumer and professional GPUs that are heterogeneous, preempti

summary.core_problem: 前沿 LLM 预训练目前被锁定在少数中心化数据中心内，因为标准分布式训练依赖同地部署、高带宽、低延迟、可靠的紧耦合加速器集群；这使得互联网上大量零散、异构、可能随时掉线的消费级 GPU 无法参与训练。论文要解决的是：能否在公网环境下、由成千上万个不可靠的、异构的、随时加入退出的参与者，无需许可地共同完成一个有意义规模的 LLM 预训练，并且达到与中心化训练接近的收敛和效率。
summary.importance: 对预训练系统研究和“去中心化训练”方向是一个值得注意的实证里程碑：它不是停留在模拟或小规模概念验证，而是真的跑完了一个 8.6B、500B token 的公开预训练。对主流基座团队的直接训练 recipe 影响有限，因为其 ML-side 改动（异步、稀疏、部分参与的参数同步等）会改变优化动态，目前只验证到“loss 曲线跟得上中心化参考”这一层，还没有到 post-train 后下游能力的对齐对比；但它清晰地指出了在极弱网络、强 churn、强异构条件下，哪些训练算法假设必须被修改（高频同步 all-reduce、固定并行拓扑、节点始终在线），这对大规模弹性训练、跨地域训练、甚至未来 federated / crowdsourced pretraining 都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: Agora 围绕三个中心化训练没有的约束重构系统：（1）模型分片以 pipeline parallelism 为主，配合 subspace networks 把跨 stage 传递的激活压缩两个数量级，让互联网带宽下的 PP 可行；（2）数据并行副本之间不做每步同步的 all-reduce，而是采用稀疏、异步的参数平均（sparse asynchronous parameter averaging），只对变化慢的权重子集做低频、后台的同步，使权重同步与计算重叠、不阻塞 optimizer step；（3）把容错从“故障恢复外挂”变成训练步本身的属性，节点随时加入/退出都不中断 run，新加入节点从过期权重追平时不破坏整体训练。在这些之上叠加 Unextractable Protocol Models（UPM）思路，因为模型是 MP 分片的，任何单个参与者都不持有完整权重，试图提供一种权重不可提取的协议层保障。训练范式整体被称为 Protocol Learning。
summary.experiments: 报告了 Pluralis-8B：8.6B 参数模型，在 FineWeb-Edu 上训练 500B tokens，持续 40 天，330 个贡献节点（主要是消费级 GPU，外加少量 operator 节点），过程中共 669 次 join、607 次 depart。训练 loss 全程紧密追踪中心化参考运行。1B 规模消融显示：在计算异构比高达 10:1 时仍可收敛；当 all-reduce 参与率下降到约 85% 以下时性能才开始退化，故障节点被剔除后可完全恢复。吞吐方面持续约 170k tokens/s，折算 4.2 tokens/TFLOP，约为中心化 H100 baseline 效率的 63%，并且在持续 churn 下保持该速率。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，但建议把它当作一份系统技术报告来读，重点看三块：Section 3 的系统设计——为什么选 PP 为主而不是 TP/FSDP、subspace networks 如何压缩跨 stage 通信、异步稀疏参数平均具体同步哪些量、频率如何；Section 4 的 ML-side 改动——异步/部分参与下学习率、batch、warmup 等需要怎么调才能保证收敛；Section 5–6 的实证——Pluralis-8B 的 loss 曲线、1B 消融里 85% 参与率和 10:1 异构容忍度这两个关键数字。若关心去中心化训练的开放问题，可进一步思考：异步+稀疏平均是否会隐式损害后期推理能力（尤其是 post-train 后的 benchmark 表现），以及 UPM 的“不可提取”在密码学/系统层面的实际强度。预计阅读时间 45–60 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Frontier LLM pretraining is currently locked inside a small number of centralized datacenters because standard distributed training assumes co-located, homogeneous, highly reliable accelerators connected by a fast fabric. This makes the enormous pool of consumer-grade GPUs scattered across the internet — heterogeneous, behind commodity links, and free to join or leave at any time — unusable for training. The paper asks whether a meaningfully large LLM can be pretrained in a permissionless way over the public internet, by thousands of unreliable, heterogeneous, churn-prone participants, while achieving convergence and efficiency close to a centralized run.
summary_en.importance: This is a notable empirical milestone for decentralized training and pretraining systems research: it is not a simulation or toy proof of concept, but an actual public pretraining run at 8.6B parameters on 500B tokens. Its direct impact on mainstream pretraining recipes is limited, since the ML-side changes (asynchronous sparse averaging, partial participation, etc.) alter optimization dynamics and are validated primarily at the level of training-loss tracking rather than post-training downstream capability. Nonetheless, it cleanly identifies which standard assumptions must break under weak networking, heavy churn, and high heterogeneity (per-step synchronous all-reduce, fixed parallel topology, always-on nodes), which is informative for elastic cross-datacenter training and future crowdsourced / federated pretraining settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: Agora is built around three constraints absent in centralized training: (1) the model is sharded primarily via pipeline parallelism, using subspace networks to compress cross-stage activations by roughly two orders of magnitude so that PP is viable over internet-grade links; (2) data-parallel replicas do not synchronize gradients with a per-step all-reduce; instead, sparse asynchronous parameter averaging exchanges only a small subset of slow-moving weights, infrequently and in the background, so weight synchronization overlaps with computation and never blocks the optimizer step; (3) fault tolerance is built into the training step rather than implemented as an external recovery mechanism, so joins, leaves, and heterogeneity are handled continuously, and newcomers catch up from stale weights without disrupting the run. On top of this, the system adopts ideas from Unextractable Protocol Models (UPM): because the model is model-parallel, no single participant ever holds the full weights, aiming to make weight extraction from individual nodes infeasible. The overall paradigm is termed Protocol Learning.
summary_en.experiments: The authors report Pluralis-8B: an 8.6B-parameter model trained on 500B FineWeb-Edu tokens over 40 days, with 330 contributor nodes (mostly consumer GPUs plus a small set of operator nodes), experiencing 669 joins and 607 departures during the run. Training loss closely tracks a centralized reference throughout. 1B-scale ablations show convergence tolerates compute heterogeneity up to 10:1; degradation appears only when all-reduce participation drops below roughly 85%, with full recovery once failing nodes are pruned. Sustained throughput is about 170k tokens/s, or 4.2 tokens/TFLOP — roughly 63% of the efficiency of a centralized H100 baseline — maintained under continuous churn.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, but treat it as a serious systems technical report. Focus on three parts: Section 3's system design — why pipeline parallelism is favored over tensor parallelism / FSDP under internet conditions, how subspace networks compress cross-stage communication, and what exactly sparse asynchronous parameter averaging synchronizes and at what frequency; Section 4's ML-side changes — how LR, batch, warmup, and related knobs must be adjusted to keep async, partially-participated training stable; Sections 5–6's empirical results — in particular the loss-tracking curve for Pluralis-8B and the two ablation thresholds: ~85% participation and 10:1 heterogeneity tolerance. For open questions, note that asynchronous sparse averaging may have subtle downstream-quality effects not visible in training loss alone, and that the UPM claim of unextractability deserves scrutiny at both the cryptographic and systems level. Estimated reading time: 45–60 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 分布式训练的一个有意思的新方向，看系统设计思路对去中心化训练有启发，但工程复杂度和实际效率存疑，重点读流水线分片和容错设计部分。
recommendation.en: An interesting new direction in distributed training with thought-provoking decentralized training ideas, though engineering complexity and real efficiency remain uncertain; focus on pipeline sharding and fault tolerance design.

paper.title: GIFT: Geometry-Informed Low-precision Gradient Communication for LLM Pretraining
paper.abstract: Gradient communication is a primary scaling bottleneck in large language model (LLM) pretraining. Communicating gradients in low-precision formats, such as FP8 and NVFP4, can significantly reduce the communication volume. Existing methods quantize gradients via linear or nonlinear mappings in Euclidean space, often degrading model performance because highly anisotropic gradients incur direction-dependent distortion. We present GIFT, a geometry-informed gradient scaling method that performs low-p

summary.core_problem: 分布式 LLM 预训练中，梯度通信占整体训练时间的比例可达 40%（128 卡 A100 训练 8.3B 模型场景）。使用 FP8 等低精度格式压缩梯度是直接的带宽优化手段，但现有方法在欧氏空间中做线性/非线性量化，会因梯度分布的高度各向异性（不同方向的方差差异大）引入方向相关的失真，导致同步后的更新方向偏离高精度基准，最终损害下游任务性能。同时，多数已有工作同时量化权重、激活、优化器状态，难以单独评估低精度梯度本身的影响，也难以平衡额外计算开销与通信收益。
summary.importance: 这是首个从黎曼几何视角系统诊断低精度梯度量化误差来源的工作，明确指出欧氏空间均匀缩放与各向异性梯度几何之间的不匹配是性能下降的核心原因。方法层面提供了一种不修改优化器、模型结构、训练配方、通信原语和数值格式的纯坐标变换方案，可直接对接 NCCL 2.24 原生 FP8 通信，工程侵入性极低。实践层面给出了“选择性几何变换”的成本-收益折中思路，让 K-FAC 类近似的额外计算开销可被通信收益覆盖，为大规模预训练中 FP8 梯度通信的落地提供了可复现的路径。
summary.technical_approach: 核心思路是在量化前将梯度变换到近似各向同性的坐标系，使 FP8 均匀缩放对不同维度引入的误差量级相当。具体实现分三步：1）误差诊断：通过 Fisher 信息矩阵白化将梯度映射到黎曼流形，验证该空间下梯度分布接近各向同性，量化误差显著低于欧氏空间；2）几何近似：采用 K-FAC 对 Fisher 矩阵做 Kronecker 分解近似，仅用于构造临时通信坐标系，不替换优化器的更新规则（仍使用 Muon 优化器的原生更新）；3）选择性应用：先逐层评估量化敏感度，仅对量化误差敏感的层执行 K-FAC 变换与逆变换，其余层沿用标准逐层欧氏缩放，控制额外计算量。整个流程只改变梯度通信时的坐标表示，不影响优化器状态存储和模型权重精度。
summary.experiments: 基于 Megatron-LM 实现，在 OpenWebText 数据集上预训练 Llama-300M 和 Llama-600M，优化器采用 Muon。误差分析显示，与欧氏逐层缩放的 FP8 基线相比，GIFT 将 FP8 梯度与 FP32 梯度的平均误差降低最多 67.4%。通信体积方面，相对 FP32 梯度减少 75%（对应 FP8 的理论压缩比）。端到端训练速度上，64 张 GH200 超芯片场景下，整体预训练时间较 FP32 减少 7.6%；同规模下直接使用欧氏 FP8 可减少 10.79% 的时间，GIFT 以约 3 个百分点的原始加速比为代价，换来了更好的下游任务性能保留。下游评估中，相同优化器和通信路径下，GIFT 预训练的模型在多数任务上的表现优于欧氏 FP8 基线，更接近 BF16/FP32 基准。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 II 节的误差诊断部分，尤其是梯度各向异性与欧氏量化误差的对应关系推导，以及 Fisher 白化后分布变化的可视化；其次关注选择性 K-FAC 变换的敏感度评估标准和层选择策略，这是控制计算开销的关键；实验部分重点对比 GIFT、欧氏 FP8、FP32 三者的梯度误差-训练时间-下游性能三维权衡，注意区分“通信体积减少”和“端到端加速比”的差异。值得深挖的点包括：该几何变换思路是否可扩展到 NVFP4 等更低精度格式、是否可与 ZeRO 等分片数据并行策略结合、量化敏感度评估是否可在训练前离线完成以进一步降低开销。

summary_en.core_problem: In distributed LLM pretraining, gradient communication can account for up to 40% of total training time (as observed in a 128-A100 setup for an 8.3B GPT-style model). Compressing gradients into low-precision formats such as FP8 directly cuts bandwidth usage, but existing methods perform linear or nonlinear quantization in Euclidean space. Because gradient distributions are highly anisotropic—variances differ drastically across directions—uniform scaling introduces direction-dependent distortion that drifts the synchronized update away from the high-precision reference, degrading downstream performance. Most prior works simultaneously quantize weights, activations, and optimizer states, making it hard to isolate the impact of low-precision gradients alone, or to balance extra compute overhead against communication savings.
summary_en.importance: This work provides the first systematic diagnosis of low-precision gradient quantization error from a Riemannian geometry perspective, identifying the mismatch between anisotropic local gradient geometry and axis-aligned Euclidean scaling as the root cause of performance degradation. The proposed solution is a pure coordinate transformation that leaves the optimizer, model architecture, training recipe, communication collectives, and numerical format untouched, enabling direct integration with NCCL 2.24 native FP8 communication with minimal engineering overhead. The selective geometry-transform strategy further makes K-FAC-style approximation practical, such that the extra compute cost is offset by communication gains. It offers a reproducible path for deploying FP8 gradient communication in large-scale pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core idea is to transform gradients into a near-isotropic coordinate system before quantization, so that uniform FP8 scaling introduces comparable error magnitudes across dimensions. The implementation has three parts: 1) Error diagnosis: Fisher information matrix whitening maps gradients onto a Riemannian manifold where the gradient distribution becomes approximately isotropic, with substantially lower quantization error than in Euclidean space. 2) Geometry approximation: K-FAC is used for Kronecker-factored approximation of the Fisher matrix, but only to construct temporary communication coordinates; the optimizer (Muon) update rule remains unchanged. 3) Selective application: Per-layer quantization sensitivity is first evaluated. K-FAC forward and inverse transforms are applied only to quantization-sensitive layers; all other layers use standard layer-wise Euclidean scaling to keep extra compute bounded. The entire pipeline only alters the coordinate representation during gradient communication and does not affect optimizer state storage or model weight precision.
summary_en.experiments: Implemented in Megatron-LM. Llama-300M and Llama-600M models are pretrained on OpenWebText with the Muon optimizer. Error analysis shows GIFT reduces the average difference between FP8 and FP32 gradients by up to 67.4% compared with a Euclidean layer-wise scaling FP8 baseline. Gradient payload size is reduced by 75% relative to FP32, matching the theoretical FP8 compression ratio. End-to-end, on 64 GH200 superchips, GIFT cuts overall pretraining time by 7.6% over FP32; direct Euclidean FP8 achieves a 10.79% reduction at the same scale, meaning GIFT trades roughly 3 percentage points of raw speedup for better downstream preservation. Under identical optimizer and communication paths, models pretrained with GIFT outperform the Euclidean FP8 baseline on most downstream tasks and stay closer to the BF16/FP32 reference.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus first on Section II's error diagnosis, especially the derivation linking gradient anisotropy to Euclidean quantization error and the visualizations of distribution change after Fisher whitening. Next, study the quantization-sensitivity metric and layer-selection policy for selective K-FAC application—this is the key mechanism that controls compute overhead. In experiments, examine the three-way tradeoff among gradient error, training wall time, and downstream performance across GIFT, Euclidean FP8, and FP32; pay attention to the distinction between communication-volume reduction and end-to-end speedup. Worth investigating further are: whether the geometry-transform framework extends to lower-precision formats like NVFP4, whether it composes with sharded data parallelism such as ZeRO, and whether quantization-sensitivity evaluation can be done offline before training to further reduce runtime overhead.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看方法和实验规模；若大模型结果扎实，GIFT 是低精度梯度通信里少见的低侵入改动。
recommendation.en: Read the method and scale details first; if the large-model results hold, GIFT is a rare low-intrusion fix for low-precision gradient communication.

paper.title: UBEP: Re-architecting Expert Parallelism Communication Library for Production Superpods
paper.abstract: The deployment of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models on production high-bandwidth superpods, such as NVIDIA's NVL72/576 and Huawei's CloudMatrix384, introduces critical challenges beyond raw interconnect bandwidth. While these systems provide unified global address spaces and high-bandwidth fabrics, their full potential for sparse MoE communication is hindered by three fundamental bottlenecks: (1) Strict execution serialization imposed by coarse-grained Bulk Synchronous Parallel (BSP) orchestration

summary.core_problem: MoE模型在生产级高带宽超级集群（如NVIDIA NVL72/576、华为CloudMatrix384）上部署时，专家并行（EP）通信无法充分利用高带宽互联的潜力，存在三个核心瓶颈：一是粗粒度BSP编排下相互依赖的通信阶段严格串行执行，并行度不足；二是全局同步开销随互联带宽提升而占比激增，成为新的性能瓶颈；三是不规则token流量的距离无关调度导致严重的负载不均衡，集群带宽利用率低。
summary.importance: MoE是当前大模型基座预训练和部署的核心架构方向之一，专家并行的通信效率直接决定了大模型训练与推理的扩展性和单位算力成本。UBEP从通信库底层重构了EP的执行范式，突破了传统BSP架构的三大瓶颈，其设计思路不仅可直接用于MoE推理部署降本提效，对大规模MoE预训练中的通信优化也有重要借鉴价值。
summary.technical_approach:
UBEP（Unified-Bus Expert Parallelism）是面向MoE低延迟推理的通信库，基于三个协同设计的核心机制：
1）内核分解（Kernel Decomposition）：打破传统BSP的串行约束，将加速器内的AIV计算单元分成独立任务组并行执行（如多数AIV负责token发送，少数AIV负责token计数计算与前缀和），用轻量级点对点同步（异步信号轮询共享内存）替代全局屏障，让无依赖的任务重叠执行。通过成本建模推导两组AIV的最优分配比例，在不损失传输带宽的前提下重叠元数据处理延迟。
2）分层token级调度（Hierarchical Token-level Scheduling）：针对超级集群内的层级化延迟差异，用硬件加速的映射器在1微秒内生成最优分配调度，解决不规则token流量的负载不均衡问题。
3）数据即标志（Data-as-Flag）：利用硬件原生的512字节原子加载/存储能力，将控制标志直接嵌入数据 payload，无需单独的控制消息即可实现隐式一致性，消除昂贵的跨NPU全局同步。
三个机制协同作用：内核分解暴露细粒度可并行任务，调度器在集群范围内平衡负载，Data-as-Flag实现无屏障的细粒度同步。
summary.experiments: 当前公开内容中完整实验部分尚未完全呈现。已披露的验证包括：通过成本建模推导了AIV分配的最优比例，并在附录中通过实验验证了模型的准确性；核心机制以dispatch阶段为主要验证场景（全局同步和负载不均衡瓶颈主要集中在该阶段），设计可推广到combine等其他EP原语。方案已适配NVIDIA NVL系列、华为CloudMatrix等生产级超级集群。

summary.authors_note: 具体作者与所属机构未在提供内容中明确，研究面向NVIDIA NVL系列、华为CloudMatrix等生产级超级集群场景。

summary_en.core_problem: When deploying Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models on production high-bandwidth superpods (e.g., NVIDIA NVL72/576, Huawei CloudMatrix384), expert parallelism (EP) communication fails to fully utilize high-bandwidth fabric potential due to three core bottlenecks: 1) Strict execution serialization from coarse-grained BSP orchestration of interdependent communication phases, limiting parallelism; 2) Prohibitive global synchronization overhead that grows as a share of total latency with increasing interconnect bandwidth, becoming a new performance bottleneck; 3) Severe load imbalance from distance-agnostic scheduling of irregular token traffic, resulting in low cluster bandwidth utilization.
summary_en.importance: MoE is one of the core architectural directions for large language model base pretraining and deployment. EP communication efficiency directly determines the scalability and per-compute cost of large model training and inference. UBEP rearchitects the EP execution paradigm from the communication library level, breaking through three major bottlenecks of traditional BSP architectures. Its design ideas can not only directly reduce costs and improve efficiency for MoE inference deployment, but also have important reference value for communication optimization in large-scale MoE pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach:
UBEP (Unified-Bus Expert Parallelism) is a communication library for low-latency MoE inference, built on three synergistic core mechanisms:
1) Kernel Decomposition: Breaks the sequential constraint of traditional BSP by partitioning on-accelerator AIV compute units into independent task groups that run in parallel (e.g., most AIVs handle token sending, while a smaller group handles token count computation and prefix sums). Lightweight point-to-point synchronization (asynchronous signal polling of shared memory) replaces global barriers, allowing overlap of independent tasks. Cost modeling derives the optimal allocation ratio between the two groups to overlap metadata processing latency without sacrificing transmission bandwidth.
2) Hierarchical Token-level Scheduling: Addresses hierarchical latency differences within superpods, using a hardware-accelerated mapper to generate optimal allocation schedules within 1 microsecond, resolving load imbalance from irregular token traffic.
3) Data-as-Flag: Leverages hardware-native 512-byte atomic load/store support to embed control flags directly in the data payload, achieving implicit consistency without separate control messages and eliminating expensive cross-NPU global synchronization.
The three mechanisms work synergistically: decomposition exposes fine-grained parallelizable tasks, scheduling balances load across the fabric, and Data-as-Flag enables barrier-free fine-grained synchronization.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental results are not fully presented in the available content. Disclosed validation includes cost modeling to derive the optimal AIV allocation ratio, with experimental verification of the model's accuracy in the appendix. Core mechanisms are primarily validated on the dispatch phase (where global synchronization and load imbalance bottlenecks are most concentrated), and the design is generalizable to other EP primitives such as the combine routine. The solution has been adapted for production superpods including NVIDIA NVL series and Huawei CloudMatrix.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus intensive reading on Chapter 3's three core technical designs (3.2 Kernel Decomposition, 3.3 Hierarchical Token-level Scheduling, 3.4 Data-as-Flag) to understand how they collectively break through the three BSP bottlenecks. The bottleneck analysis in Chapter 2 is worth careful reading to build a systematic understanding of MoE communication challenges. Appendix A (cost modeling) and Appendix C (experimental verification) provide detailed reference value. It is recommended to first read the overview to establish the overall framework, then dive into the design details and tradeoffs of each mechanism.
summary_en.authors_note: Specific authors and affiliations are not clearly disclosed in the provided content; the research targets production superpod scenarios such as NVIDIA NVL series and Huawei CloudMatrix.

recommendation.zh: MoE大规模预训练核心通信优化的生产级方案，应立刻在内部MoE训练栈复现验证实际收益。
recommendation.en: Production-grade core communication optimization for large-scale MoE pretraining, should be immediately reproduced in internal MoE training stack for validation.

paper.title: Can Model Merging Improve Aggregation in DiLoCo?
paper.abstract: Model merging techniques, which aggregate independently finetuned models into one to combine their capabilities, have become a topic of significant interest in recent years, with a broad array of methods having been proposed to tackle this problem. Simultaneously, an emerging trend in distributed learning has been the use of methods such as local SGD and DiLoCo, which greatly reduce communication costs by periodically aggregating the independently trained local models. However, these communicati

summary.core_problem: DiLoCo等低通信量分布式预训练方法，随worker数量增加或本地训练步数延长，性能会相较于FLOP匹配的标准数据并行训练出现明显下降。现有外层优化器聚合方式未能有效缓解多本地模型独立训练带来的参数更新冲突问题。
summary.importance: 明确建立了低通信分布式训练的聚合过程与模型合并问题的理论类比，将DiLoCo中的伪梯度对应到模型合并中的任务向量，为分布式预训练聚合策略的优化提供了跨领域的研究方向，可支撑低通信训练模式的可扩展性提升。
summary.technical_approach: 提出将模型合并领域中用于减少任务干扰的方法迁移到DiLoCo的全局聚合环节。具体来说，把每轮本地训练产生的参数变化（伪梯度）视为任务向量，将原本由外层SGD优化器完成的聚合替换为抗干扰的模型合并策略，以此缓解多worker独立训练带来的参数更新冲突，提升大worker数、长本地步场景下的训练性能。
summary.experiments: 当前提供的论文片段仅包含引言与研究动机部分，未披露完整的方法实现与实验结果。论文核心贡献在于提出跨领域的问题关联与优化思路，具体效果有待实验验证。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点为引言部分的类比逻辑，理解DiLoCo性能退化的本质与模型合并中任务干扰现象的共通性。若需深入可关注后续方法章节中具体采用的合并策略选型，以及不同worker数量、本地训练步数下的性能对比实验。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Low-communication distributed pretraining methods like DiLoCo experience measurable performance degradation relative to FLOP-matched standard data-parallel training as the number of workers or local training steps grows. Existing outer-optimizer-based aggregation fails to effectively resolve parameter update conflicts across independently trained local model replicas.
summary_en.importance: This work establishes an explicit theoretical analogy between the aggregation process in low-communication distributed training and the model merging problem, mapping DiLoCo's pseudo-gradients to task vectors in model merging. This cross-domain connection provides a new research direction for optimizing aggregation strategies in distributed pretraining, and can support improved scalability of low-communication training regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core idea is to adapt interference-mitigating model merging methods to the global aggregation step of DiLoCo. Specifically, parameter updates generated during each round of local training (pseudo-gradients) are treated as task vectors, and the original outer SGD optimizer aggregation is replaced with interference-reducing merging strategies. This is designed to alleviate parameter update conflicts from multi-worker independent training, and improve performance in scenarios with high worker counts and long local step intervals.
summary_en.experiments: The provided paper fragment only covers the introduction and research motivation, with full method implementation and experimental results undisclosed. The core contribution lies in the proposed cross-domain problem framing and optimization direction, with concrete effectiveness pending experimental validation.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the analogy logic in the introduction to understand the commonality between DiLoCo performance degradation and task interference in model merging. For deeper follow-up, review the method section for specific merging strategy choices, and the experiment section for performance comparisons across varying worker counts and local step sizes. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 aggregation 推导和大 local-step 表格；若只在小模型验证，可作为 DiLoCo ablation 候选而非训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Read the aggregation derivation and large-local-step tables; if tested only on small models, treat it as a DiLoCo ablation candidate, not a recipe.

paper.title: Not Every Sync Is Safe: Calibrated DiLoCo Scheduling for Shared AI Infrastructure
paper.abstract: DiLoCo-style training reduces communication by letting learner islands train locally before occasional outer synchronization, making it attractive for fragmented industrial AI fleets where training shares hardware with latency-sensitive serving. The question for such fleets is when an outer merge is worth its system cost, and whether choosing \emph{which} windows to defer matters at all. Existing scheduling studies evaluate workload-aware policies against fixed-period baselines, but most omit th

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的不是 DiLoCo 本身能不能省通信，而是共享算力环境里“什么时候做 outer sync 才安全”这个调度判定问题。工业环境里训练常和在线 serving 共用主机、网络、checkpoint 资源，outer merge 一旦落在高压窗口，会直接伤害延迟敏感业务。已有工作多比较固定周期、简单 pressure gate 或 workload-aware 策略，但没有把“同步次数预算”和“同步时机选择”拆开评估，因此很容易把预算控制误当成 workload awareness。作者要解决的核心问题，是给 DiLoCo 同步调度建立一个可校准的评估协议：只有当某个调度器在相同同步预算下，能稳定优于随机放置这些同步窗口，才说明它真的学到了何时同步，而不只是少同步。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在训练系统与共享基础设施接口，而不是优化算法本身。DiLoCo、异步/低频同步、跨地域训练这些方向越来越接近真实生产环境，问题不再只是通信量，而是训练事件如何与 serving 共存。这篇工作的贡献有两层。第一层是方法论：提出 matched random deferral 作为必要对照，把“预算”与“放置”解耦，这个评估思路对任何 workload-aware training scheduler 都适用。第二层是经验结论：在不少 regime 下，简单 workload-aware 策略并不能打赢预算匹配的随机延后，这说明很多系统论文里关于‘智能调度’的收益，可能混入了预算变化或负载分布偏置。对做大规模预训练的人，这篇文章提醒的是：共享集群上的训练调度，先要证明 placement 有价值，再谈部署。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上，文章的主线不是提出一个复杂调度器，而是提出一套校准后的判定流程，并用 WA-DiLoCo 作为载体来验证。WA-DiLoCo 把 outer sync 看成一个可移动的、持续 D 秒的干扰事件，在满足最小/最大同步间隔 H 的 corridor 内决定是否执行。作者强调，在 matched tokens 条件下，短程 train loss 对这些 sync 在 corridor 内的具体放置并不敏感，因此问题可以近似化成单边调度：把同步尽量移出 serving 高成本窗口，同时不破坏训练预算。

核心设计有三部分。第一，matched random deferral：先运行某个候选调度器，得到它实际使用的 merge budget，再事后随机化这些 merge 的放置位置，形成一个不可部署但统计上公平的对照。这样可以回答一个关键问题：如果只是同样少同步、但时机随机，效果是否已经差不多？若答案是是，那么 workload-aware claim 就站不住。第二，calibrated overlap model：作者用 serving sidecar replay 和 no-sync load match 去校准“某个 sync 窗口与 serving 请求重叠时会带来多大 SLO 代价”，把调度从抽象时间序列问题变成有代价函数的 placement 问题。第三，bounded scheduling formulation：在 min/max-H 约束下，离线版本利用已知未来负载做近似最优放置；在线版本则用预先指定的 EWMA forecaster 预测 overlap 信号，在预测误差存在时平滑退化。

和已有 DiLoCo 变体相比，这里没有改 outer optimizer、通信压缩或容错机制，而是把 outer sync 当成共享资源上的“训练事件”来调度。和一般集群调度器相比，它也不是做全局 goodput 优化，而是专门问：某次 merge 现在做，是否值得它对 serving SLO 的代价。
summary.experiments:
实验重点是 regime study，而不是单一平均指标。文中在受控 stress test 和真实 vLLM sidecar replay 上考察了 ordinary、pressure-heavy、steady sync-heavy、bursty、non-periodic 等多种负载形态。结论很明确：

1. 在 pressure-heavy、接近饱和的负载下，调度空间本来就很小，任何策略都难以显著改善 serving，说明这类场景下 workload-aware sync 基本没有可兑现收益。
2. 在 steady sync-heavy 负载下，WA-DiLoCo 可以优于固定周期和简单 gated baseline，但仍未稳定超过 matched random。这说明收益主要来自减少或推迟同步，而不是精确挑时机。
3. 在 bursty 负载下，服务代价结构更明显，离线 calibrated scheduling 能接近 matched-budget 类中的近优放置；在线版本若只靠简单规则会掉队，但加入基于同一 overlap 信号构建的 EWMA forecaster 后，可以在真实 sidecar replay 中超过 matched random。
4. 作者还给出一个重要训练侧结果：在 token 数匹配时，sync placement 对短程 train loss 基本不敏感，文中提到 Table 8 支持这一点。这是整篇文章能把问题化约为 serving-aware placement 的前提。

摘要里给出的一个具体系统配置是 outer merge 持续 D=8 秒。全文更重要的不是单个绝对数字，而是 effect-size transfer、no-sync load match、matched-random envelope 这三步控制实验。它们让读者能区分：某个策略到底是在改善 placement，还是只是在换预算、换负载、换评估口径。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三件事。第一，看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，理解作者为什么坚持把 matched random 当成必要对照；这是全文最有信息量的判断。第二，看方法部分里 min/max-H corridor、overlap calibration、offline/online scheduling 的定义，弄清楚它不是一般的集群调度，而是预算受限的 sync placement。第三，看实验里的 regime map，尤其是哪些场景下 WA-DiLoCo 输给 matched random，哪些场景下加了 EWMA forecast 才真正赢。

如果只花 20–30 分钟，建议顺序是：Introduction → 方法总览图/公式 → real sidecar replay 结果 → Table 8。阅读时重点问两个问题：一，作者是否真的把预算控制和时机选择分开了；二，训练损失对 placement 不敏感这个前提在多大范围内成立。若要深挖，可以继续看 calibration protocol 的细节，因为这部分比具体调度器更可迁移。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about whether DiLoCo reduces communication; it is about when an outer synchronization should be allowed in a shared fleet. In production, training often competes with latency-sensitive serving for host, network, and checkpoint resources. An outer merge placed in the wrong window can hurt serving SLOs even if the overall sync frequency is low. Prior scheduling work usually compares workload-aware policies against fixed-period baselines, but it does not cleanly separate sync budget from sync placement. This paper targets that gap: a scheduler should only earn a workload-aware claim if, under the same synchronization budget, it beats a budget-matched random placement of merges.
summary_en.importance: The contribution matters more as training-systems methodology than as a new optimization recipe. Low-communication pretraining, cross-cluster training, and fragmented fleets are becoming practical concerns, and the bottleneck is no longer only bandwidth. It is whether training-side events can coexist with serving. The paper contributes a useful evaluation principle: matched random deferral is a necessary control if one wants to claim that timing matters. It also delivers a sobering empirical result: in several regimes, simple workload-aware schedulers do not beat budget-matched random placement. For pretraining researchers, the message is clear: before deploying serving-aware synchronization logic, one should verify that placement itself adds value beyond merely reducing or delaying syncs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main technical contribution is a calibrated evaluation protocol, with WA-DiLoCo used as the vehicle rather than the centerpiece. WA-DiLoCo treats each outer sync as a movable interference event of duration D, and decides whether to place it now or defer it within a min/max-H corridor. A key empirical premise is that, at matched token count, short-run training loss is largely insensitive to where syncs are placed inside that corridor. That lets the authors reduce the problem to one-sided scheduling: move merges away from expensive serving windows without violating the synchronization budget.

There are three core pieces. First, matched random deferral: after observing the actual merge budget used by a candidate scheduler, the evaluator randomizes the placement of those same merges post hoc. This produces a non-deployable but fair control. If the candidate cannot beat this control, it has demonstrated budget control, not workload awareness. Second, a calibrated overlap model: using sidecar replay and no-sync load matching, the paper estimates the serving-side cost induced when a merge overlaps with live requests. This turns scheduling into a placement problem with a measurable cost function. Third, a bounded scheduling formulation: under min/max-H constraints, an offline calibrated scheduler can approach near-optimal placement within the matched-budget class, while an online version uses a pre-specified EWMA forecaster over the same overlap signal and degrades gracefully under forecast error.

Relative to prior DiLoCo variants, the paper does not modify the optimizer, communication payload, or fault tolerance. It reframes outer sync as a schedulable training event in shared infrastructure. Relative to generic cluster schedulers, it is narrower and cleaner: the question is not global goodput, but whether a merge is worth its serving-side cost right now.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized as a regime study rather than a single average-case benchmark. The paper evaluates controlled stress tests and real vLLM sidecar replays under ordinary, pressure-heavy, steady sync-heavy, bursty, and non-periodic serving traces.

The main findings are consistent and useful. Under pressure-heavy, near-saturated load, there is little room for any scheduler to help; workload-aware sync has limited realizable value. Under steady sync-heavy load, WA-DiLoCo beats fixed-period and simple gated baselines, but does not reliably beat matched random deferral, suggesting that much of the gain comes from budget reduction or coarse postponement rather than precise placement. Under bursty load, the serving-cost structure becomes exploitable: offline calibrated scheduling is near-optimal within the matched-budget class, and the online version becomes competitive only after adding an EWMA forecaster built from the same overlap signal. In real sidecar replay, that forecasted online variant beats matched random.

A training-side result is also important: with matched tokens, sync placement has little effect on short-run train loss; the paper points to Table 8 for this. That empirical fact is what makes the serving-aware placement abstraction credible. One concrete system number mentioned early is D = 8 seconds for an outer merge in their setup, but the more important experimental contribution is the control structure: effect-size transfer, no-sync load match, and the matched-random envelope. Those controls make it possible to tell whether a scheduler improves placement or merely changes budget, workload, or evaluation conditions.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the first motivating figure carefully; the insistence on matched random deferral is the paper’s sharpest idea. Second, read the scheduling formulation around the min/max-H corridor, overlap calibration, and the offline versus online variants. That section clarifies that this is not generic cluster scheduling but budget-constrained sync placement. Third, inspect the regime-wise experimental results, especially the cases where WA-DiLoCo loses to matched random and the cases where EWMA forecasting finally creates a real advantage.

A practical 20–30 minute path is: Introduction → method overview and key equations → real sidecar replay results → Table 8. While reading, keep two questions in mind: did the evaluation truly separate sync budget from sync timing, and how robust is the claim that training loss is insensitive to placement within the allowed corridor? If more time is available, the calibration protocol is the part most worth deeper study because it is more reusable than the specific scheduler.

recommendation.zh: 戳破了近期DiLoCo调度论文的基线漏洞，同预算随机调度就能打平多数启发式策略，做分布式训练的重点看基线对照部分即可。
recommendation.en: It exposes a pervasive baseline flaw in recent DiLoCo scheduling papers: budget-matched random deferral matches most heuristic policies; focus on the control design if you work on distributed training.

paper.title: Mixture-of-Parallelisms: Towards Memory-Efficient Training Stack for Mixture-of-Experts Models
paper.abstract: This paper showcases a memory-efficient training stack for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. It is a training paradigm that combines and specializes various existing and novel parallelism techniques at different layers and stages of the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model training pipeline. It leverages these techniques to achieve maximal efficiency given the physical constraints of CPU, CPU memory, GPU HBM memory, and the CPU-GPU, GPU-GPU, and node-node communication bandwidth of the GPU cluster. It

summary.core_problem: 现有万亿参数长上下文MoE模型训练普遍采用全局统一的并行策略，无法匹配注意力、MoE前馈、词表投影、优化器状态等不同组件的差异化瓶颈，导致GPU显存、互联带宽、CPU/主机内存等资源利用率低，无法在有限硬件下支撑百万上下文的万亿参数训练。
summary.importance: 打破了全局统一并行策略的设计惯性，提出按组件瓶颈匹配并行方式的系统设计范式，大幅降低了万亿级MoE预训练与微调的硬件门槛；给出了长上下文MoE训练的内存-带宽瓶颈拆解方法，以及三个无损优化的具体实现，为后续大模型训练系统设计提供了可复用的组件级并行方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出混合并行（MoP）训练栈，放弃全局统一并行计划，为MoE模型的每个组件匹配对应瓶颈的分片策略，且所有并行方式在秩级别保持类数据并行特性（每个设备持有不同token分片和对应权重分片），避免3D并行的秩乘法开销。核心包含三个无损优化：1）基于最小负载专家并行（LLEP）的内存高效专家并行，将路由通信与专家计算重叠，降低MoE激活的瞬时内存占用同时保留LLEP的加速效果；2）数据-张量混合分片的词表投影，无需实例化O(NV)规模的logit张量即可计算精确损失和梯度，且满足类数据并行的秩不变性；3）流水线式优化器更新，通过计算-通信重叠压缩优化器步骤的关键路径耗时。所有优化均为无损，不改变训练语义。
summary.experiments: 在120B、600B、1T参数的MoE模型上分别用2、8、12台8×H200节点训练，与最优调参的FSDP2基线相比，MoP的单GPU吞吐量提升4.7~8.2倍，且模型规模越大优势越明显；FSDP2在上下文长度超过64K~128K时即显存耗尽，而MoP可稳定支持最高1M token的上下文训练，且吞吐量随上下文增长几乎保持平稳，万亿参数规模下每步耗时基本由前向/反向计算主导。
summary.reading_guide: 预计阅读时间20-25分钟。重点关注第3.1-3.2节的组件级瓶颈分析与并行策略匹配逻辑、第3.3-3.5节的三个核心无损优化的具体实现、第4节的不同规模模型与上下文长度下的吞吐量/内存对比图表；训练系统方向研究者可深挖附录中通信重叠的实现细节，预训练配方方向研究者可重点关注硬件资源利用率的拆解部分。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing trillion-parameter long-context MoE training relies on uniform global parallelism strategies that fail to match the distinct bottlenecks of different components (attention, MoE feed-forward, vocabulary projection, optimizer state), resulting in underutilization of GPU HBM, interconnect bandwidth, CPU/host memory, and making million-context trillion-parameter training infeasible on limited hardware budgets.
summary_en.importance: Breaks the conventional design inertia of uniform global parallelism, proposes a component-matched parallelism paradigm that drastically reduces the hardware barrier for trillion-scale MoE pretraining and fine-tuning. It also provides a structured memory-bandwidth bottleneck decomposition for long-context MoE training, along with three lossless optimizations that serve as reusable building blocks for future large model training system design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Mixture-of-Parallelisms (MoP), a training stack that abandons uniform global parallel plans and assigns sharding strategies matched to each MoE component's dominant bottleneck. All composed parallelism methods maintain a data-parallel-like rank invariant (each device holds a distinct token shard and corresponding weight shard), avoiding the rank multiplication overhead of 3D parallelism. Three core lossless optimizations are included: 1) A memory-efficient expert parallelism built on Least-Loaded Expert Parallelism (LLEP) that overlaps routing communication with expert computation to reduce transient MoE activation footprint while preserving LLEP speedups; 2) A sharded data-tensor-parallel vocabulary projection that computes exact loss and gradients without materializing the O(NV) logit tensor, while respecting the data-parallel rank invariant; 3) A pipelined optimizer update scheme that compresses critical path time via computation-communication overlap. All optimizations preserve exact training semantics.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 120B, 600B, and 1T parameter MoE models trained on 2, 8, and 12 8×H200 nodes respectively. Compared to the best-tuned FSDP2 baseline, MoP delivers 4.7–8.2× higher per-GPU throughput, with advantages widening as model scale grows. FSDP2 runs out of memory at context lengths beyond 64K–128K, while MoP stably supports up to 1M token context with nearly flat throughput across context lengths; per-step wall time at trillion-parameter scale is essentially bounded by forward and backward compute.
summary_en.reading_guide: Estimated reading time 20-25 minutes.
